{{Top|leg}}
''' SCC Number Four''' was a [[subsidiary computer center]] just south of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In order to take down the planet's [[Planetary shield/Legends|shields]], [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] led an assault on the center to take control of the [[Orbital Solar Energy Transfer Satellite|orbital mirrors]].
